Symbol: TATAPOWER  
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
  
Analyst Call Recording 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, as amended, we hereby inform the exchanges that the Board of Directors of the 
Company, at its meeting held on Monday, July 27, 2026, approved the financial results of the Company 
for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.  
 
In this regard, the Company scheduled an Analyst Call today to discuss the aforesaid financial results 
and the audio call recording of the same is available on the Company’s website. 
 
The link to access the said audio call recording is: 
 
 
https://www.tatapower.com/investor-resource-center/analyst-call-recordings-tab   
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
 
Yours Sincerely, 
 For The Tata Power Company Limited 
 
 
 
                                                               Vispi S. Patel
